title: Trace2Eval: Contextualized Evaluation of Coding Agents from Real-World Traces
abstract: arXiv:2611.06506v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used in real-world workflows across diverse domains, motivating evaluation grounded in real user tasks. Existing benchmarks, however, largely rely on static public tasks with reference patches or hidden tests. Next-generation coding-agent benchmarks should therefore move beyond correctness on fixed tasks toward continually renewed evaluation of overall artifact quality in real user workflows.   We propose Trace2Eval, a dynamically updatable pipeline that constructs benchmarks from real-world interaction trajectories. Trace2Eval employs a multi-agent reconstruction system to analyze the filtered trajectory, recover the original user query, restore the workspace files to their pre-interaction state, and rebuild a trajectory-equivalent execution environment. translated_title: Trace2Eval：基于真实世界轨迹的编码智能体情境化评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06506v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：编码智能体在跨领域的真实工作流程中的应用日益广泛，这促使评估工作应立足于真实的用户任务。然而，现有基准主要依赖于带有参考补丁或隐藏测试的静态公开任务。因此，下一代编码智能体基准应超越对固定任务正确性的评估，转向在真实用户工作流程中对整体产出质量的持续更新评估。我们提出了Trace2Eval，一个可动态更新的流水线，用于从真实世界的交互轨迹中构建基准。Trace2Eval采用多智能体重建系统来分析筛选后的轨迹，恢复原始用户查询，将工作区文件还原至交互前的状态，并重建与轨迹等效的执行环境。随后，候选智能体执行重建的查询以生成初始产出。为了评估这些产出，该流水线迭代地细化人工……
tldr: 提出了Trace2Eval，一个可动态更新的流水线，通过多智能体重建系统从真实世界的交互轨迹中恢复用户查询、工作区状态和执行环境，从而对编码智能体在真实用户工作流程中的产出质量进行情境化、持续更新的评估。
en_tdlr: Trace2Eval is a dynamically updatable pipeline that builds coding-agent benchmarks from real-world interaction traces, using a multi-agent reconstruction system to recover the original user query, workspace state, and execution environment, enabling contextualized and continually refreshed evaluation of artifact quality in real user workflows.
